subject: Re: 🔵{Brand} & MobUpps
body:
Hi RECIPIENT_NAME,
Following up on my earlier email about paying per validated web sale rather than per click. With US apparel ecommerce rebounding to 6.5% growth this year as the category nears $250 billion, competition for orders is tightening and blended acquisition cost for fashion now runs about $90 to $120 per customer. That is the spread where return-adjusted, cost-per-sale payout protects your real cost per order. We measure against a holdout, so the sales we credit are incremental to demand a brand like Revolve already wins. Worth comparing against your current channel mix?
angle: fresh angle: 2026 US apparel ecommerce rebound to 6.5% (sourced) + fashion CAC band $90-$120
register_notes: Stage 2 EN ecommerce CPS: acknowledges 2nd follow-up + references prior in first sentence; fresh angle = timely 2026 development (US apparel ecommerce growth rebounding to 6.5%, ~$250B, emarketer) + sourced fashion CAC band $90-$120 (eightx); rotates to Revolve from candidate list; holdout incrementality referenced with no figure; market context retrieved and verified; exactly 1 question mark; native register; no sign-off; no 'X, not Y' (positive 'rather than per click').
